## Free to learn, licenses pending

OroujiLab Learning is being prepared as a **free and open educational resource**. The repository is currently private, and **the following licensing choices have not been approved or issued yet**. Until formal license files and notices are adopted by the rights holder, do not assume that all material can be redistributed under an open license.

| Material | Proposed license or status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Original website software, scripts and reusable CSS | [MIT License](https://opensource.org/license/mit) | Attribution and preservation of copyright/license notice |
| Original instructional text, original scientific vector illustrations and authored teaching handouts | [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Credit, link to license, indicate modifications |
| Epigenome Lab molecular logo/emblem | **Separately reserved; not included in the proposed CC BY grant** | Reuse governed by its rights holder |
| Referenced papers, screenshots, externally hosted data and software dependencies | Rights retained by original providers | Follow cited sources and dependency licenses |
| Synthetic exercise data | Awaiting explicit licensing statement | Clearly marked as illustrative, not clinical or experimental data |

### Why separate licenses?

A permissive software license suits scripts and reusable infrastructure. CC BY 4.0 is better aligned with attribution for original educational prose and figures. Neither grant should automatically transfer ownership or reuse rights in the lab emblem or third-party content.

### Citing the teaching resources

For an educational use, identify the specific page title, **OroujiLab Learning**, its URL and the date you accessed it; include the relevant original scientific publications cited on that lesson's reference list. Original synthetic teaching diagrams are **not** figures reproduced from the scientific papers.

A precise versioned citation, persistent website address and public contact will be established when publishing is approved.

## Corrections and provenance

Figures were authored specifically for this educational project; conceptually derived information should be verified with the cited primary works. No copyrighted Nature/Science/Cell publisher figure is reproduced without a separate permission or applicable license. Manuscript-specific unpublished HiC-ECC results are excluded until a public release is approved.

For the detailed asset inventory and editorial review status, consult the project's SOURCE_ATTRIBUTION.md and LAUNCH_READINESS.md in the GitHub repository.
